name: High Priest The
overview: The High Priest holds a unique and sacred role, symbolized by the intricately crafted breastplate described in Exodus 28:15-20, which features four rows of precious stones set in gold. These stones represent the judgment and memorial duties of the High Priest as he bears the names of Israel before the Lord. This detailed craftsmanship emphasizes the gravity and holiness of his office, highlighting his responsibility to intercede for God's people.
